verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent provider, so publishing per-state appointment details (agent address, designating form, filer) is a fair question and the axis applies. Both probes hit walls: robots.txt on www.wolterskluwer.com returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge, and the legacy ct.wolterskluwer.com host redirects into that same walled host. No page content was retrieved, so there is no evidence of per-state agent addresses, designation forms, or filing responsibility. Confidence is low because this reflects inaccessibility, not documented absence.
